The main takeaway from our work is that
the tertiary structure of the tsHHRZ is more stable than that of the mHHRZ, and that the stability of the tertiary structure of RNA molecules is important for the binding of metal ions.
tertiary interactions can have a dramatic effect on the binding of small metal ions to the RNA structure, which may have implications for RNA catalysis and metal ion catalysis in general.
the tertiary interactions in the RNA fold stabilize the metal binding site, leading to a more stable and less dynamic structure.
